================================================================================
PETIKA — Single Page Portfolio & Case Study Showcase
Commercial HTML5 + Bootstrap 5 Website Template (Dark & Light Theme)
Version: 1.0.0
Author: KD Themes
Website: https://kdthemes.com
================================================================================

INTRODUCTION
============
Thank you for purchasing Petika!
Petika is an elite commercial single-page portfolio website template engineered 
specifically for Senior Product Designers, Creative Technologists, Design Engineers, 
and Digital Consultants. Built on modern Bootstrap 5.3.3 and pure Vanilla JavaScript 
(ES6+), Petika delivers Neo-Editorial Bento Grid storytelling, zero-FOUT dual theme 
switching, in-page case study modals, and sub-second load times.

KEY FEATURES
============
- Dual Theme Engine (Dark & Light Theme) with persistent localStorage & Zero FOUT
- Bootstrap 5.3.3 Framework (Local minified distribution, zero CDN lock-in)
- 100% Vanilla JavaScript (Zero jQuery, zero monolithic runtime dependencies)
- Neo-Editorial Bento Grid Architecture (Hero, About, Works, Skills, Reviews, Contact)
- Interactive In-Page Project Case Study Modal (Challenge vs Solution, Metrics, Tags)
- Pure Vanilla JS Category Filtering (All, Product Design, Web Apps, Mobile, Brand)
- Live Availability Pulse Beacon ("Available for Projects") with timezone bar
- 1-Click Copy Contact Pills (Email, Phone, Location) with clipboard feedback
- Client-Side Validated Contact Form with anti-spam honeypot & alert banner
- Animated Metric Number Counters powered by IntersectionObserver
- 6-Viewport Responsive Layout (375px to 1920px) with Zero Horizontal Scroll
- 100% WCAG 2.1 AA Contrast & Keyboard Accessibility Compliance
- W3C Valid Semantic HTML5 Markup
- Complete In-Browser HTML Documentation Manual Included

PACKAGE DIRECTORY STRUCTURE
===========================
Petika/
├── HTML/                  : Production HTML pages & assets (index.html, 404.html)
│   ├── assets/            : Local CSS, Vanilla JS, and SVG vector assets
│   │   ├── css/           : bootstrap.min.css & style.css (tokens & BEM components)
│   │   ├── js/            : bootstrap.bundle.min.js & main.js (interactive modules)
│   │   └── images/        : logo/, projects/, avatar/
├── assets/                : Root copy of production assets for flexible deployment
├── documentation/         : Standalone, styled in-browser manual (index.html)
├── licensing/             : Commercial license agreement & open-source credits
├── README.txt             : Quick start guide (this file)
├── CHANGELOG.txt          : Version history & release notes
└── SUPPORT.txt            : Support policy & contact channels

QUICK START
===========
1. Extract the downloaded ZIP archive.
2. Navigate to the "HTML/" folder.
3. Double-click "index.html" to open the template directly in any web browser.
4. No Node.js, Webpack, npm, or build tools are required. Everything works out of the box.

HOW TO CUSTOMIZE BRAND COLORS (UNDER 60 SECONDS)
================================================
Open "assets/css/style.css" in any code editor (VS Code, Sublime, Notepad++).
Locate the ":root" block around lines 15-30:
  --amber-500: #F59E0B; /* Dark Mode Primary Accent */
  --amber-600: #D97706; /* Light Mode Primary Accent */
Update these two HEX values with your brand's color. All badges, buttons, borders, 
and hover states will automatically recalculate.

DOCUMENTATION
=============
For complete step-by-step customization guides, component breakdowns, and deployment 
instructions, open "documentation/index.html" in your browser.
